text:
marina: Heads-up — during qx6b bring-up I noticed the prompt bank has a long tail of very long prompts with embedded emails/phone-ish tokens (likely scraped). We should do a targeted de-id + stratified burn-in before running quant experiments.

ajay: +1. Do you have a quick strat plan? want to avoid biasing the holdout.

marina: Thinking: 1) detect candidate PII via heuristics (email/phone/ssn regex), 2) sample long-tail stratum (>512 tokens) and medium stratum (128-512) with 2% and 1% golden injection respectively, 3) run de-id pass then light manual review on the golden.

carmen: sounds sensible. For the golden — can we keep the original and de-identified pair so evals can measure hallucination regressions?

marina: yes, store pairs. Also want a small canary to run before quant4b: 300 examples across strata with labels for adequacy/PII leakage.

sam: who will own the review bursts? I can carve out 4 hours tomorrow for label work if we schedule batches.

marina: appreciate it. plan: label-bot will enqueue 3 batches of 100 to the "curation-review" flow, assign to reviewers: @sam, @oliver, @carmen. label-bot: I'll post the tasks in 5m. :robot_face:

label-bot: Tasks created: batch-3890-1 (100), batch-3890-2 (100), batch-3890-3 (100). Review checklist pinned in thread.

oliver: quick Q — for quant experiments we need non-deid holdout too. Where do we store the mapping?

marina: mapping lives in /mnt/curation/pairmaps/qx6b/3890123456.csv (S3 link in the checklist). Access limited to eng-ml + security approved.

ajay: also suggest adding token-length bucketing in the eval harness so we can break down quality regressions by ctxlen post-quant. small patch: 

```python
# bucket lengths
def bucket_len(n):
    if n>1024: return 'very-long'
    if n>512: return 'long'
    if n>128: return 'mid'
    return 'short'
```

marina: perfect — oliver can you attach the harness patch and the golden labels when ready?

oliver: will do. ETA EOD. I'll also flag any examples where de-id seems lossy — want to keep that signal.

carmen: one more: add a note to the rollup that quantized model should be compared on the paired deid/orig set to detect new hallucinations introduced by de-id+quant.

marina: agreed. I'll update the runbook and post a short summary after review is done. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — starting review in 10m.
